scopes.title: Homelab | System Overall
scopes.summary: Main subsystems and their shaping concerns
scopes.coverage: Native concerns below cover the modeled intake slice within the overall system. Other subsystem intent, constraints and evidence remain mapped to their existing owners.

scopes.title: Software intake
scopes.summary: Controlled acquisition, forwarding and disposable reuse
scopes.coverage: Connected intake concerns derive from native use-case/scenario, functional allocation and requirement relationships. External actor obligations retain their own owner.

scopes.title: Policy proxy
scopes.summary: Admit requests, forward HTTP and relay source TLS
scopes.coverage: The proxy owns its allocated behavior. Client verification and independent egress enforcement are related interaction obligations, not proxy features.

scopes.title: Object cache
scopes.summary: Rebuildable response storage; independent recovery remains separate
scopes.coverage: This component selects HTTP reuse scenarios through its cache-function allocation. It does not inherit every intake scenario or external-client obligation.
